rationale: Gates the m37 dart wave findings that the differential cannot see: DARTD7 per-site duplicate relationship rows (4 IconData construction sites dedup to one per source; 2 make() sites to one calls edge), DARTD8 local functions are not symbols and fold into the enclosing function (topFn->helperCall, never from localHelper), DARTD9 class-member initializer attribution to the owning class (IconSet->IconData) with module source reserved for true top-level (dedup-and-attribution->TopWidget), DARTD10 top-level getters are Property symbols (activeKeys), and DARTD6 field dataType extraction for explicit-typed fields (acorn meta.dataType=IconData). Master-review wave 2 adds DARTD12-DARTD17: accessor pairs survive dedup (Counter.value x2), param types extracted (int/double/String + this-param field binding Pay), mixin on-clause heritage (Flow->Base), enhanced-enum heritage + in-file interface override (Poly implements Shape, Poly.area->Shape.area), annotation-gated external-base overrides (Banner.toString->Object.toString, external base retargeted onto the Object interface with firstHeritageParent=StatelessWidget; fields like Poly.sides never override), and the existing make() count pin doubles as the cascade/dedup regression guard.

expectRelationships.note: 2026-10-08: the member's PUBLISHED spelling (`Owner.member`), not its bare name
DARTD14: mixin on-clause heritage — 2026-10-18 relabelled `references` (an `on` constraint is not inheritance), with isMixinOn kept

DARTD16 annotation-gated external-base override, retargeted onto the Object interface. The base is deliberately undeclared here, so the edge is a genuine cross-file fallback rather than an in-file resolution; a local stub of StatelessWidget would make it the latter and refute nothing. `StatelessWidget` declares no `toString` of its own — every Dart class inherits that member from `Object` — so the pre-retarget target named a member that does not exist. Measured: 2,422 of 247,737 `overrides` rows had that shape. `firstHeritageParent` carries the name the pre-retarget rule would have used, so the retarget loses no information.
